chapters.title: A Portrait of the Author as a Learning Junkie
chapters.sourcePressure: The source opens on overloaded modern life, challenges the misuse of a 10,000-hour mastery benchmark, and separates practical competence from elite performance while naming early frustration as the reason many learners quit.
chapters.coreMove: Reprice a postponed skill by defining the first honest competence threshold instead of measuring the first hour against mastery.
chapters.commonMisread: The weak version says every skill can become easy in a weekend or that mastery no longer matters.

chapters.title: 10 Principles of Rapid Skill Acquisition
chapters.sourcePressure: The source lists the rapid acquisition operating system: lovable project, one skill at a time, target performance level, deconstruction, critical tools, removed barriers, made time, fast feedback loops, short bursts, quantity, and speed.
chapters.coreMove: Turn a competence target into a low-friction practice loop that produces corrected reps quickly.
chapters.commonMisread: The weak version treats the ten principles as motivational tips instead of a design system for practice.

chapters.title: 10 Principles of Effective Learning
chapters.sourcePressure: The source lists effective learning principles that bound preparation and feed practice: research but not too much, jump in, mental models and hooks, imagine the opposite, talk to practitioners, eliminate distractions, spaced repetition, scaffolds and checklists, predictions and tests, and honoring biology.
chapters.coreMove: Make study earn its place by turning it into a prediction, scaffold, practitioner cue, or test that changes the next rep.
chapters.commonMisread: The weak version says studying is bad and only action matters.

chapters.title: Yoga
chapters.sourcePressure: The source frames the yoga case through simplification, working with an instructor, clearing misconceptions, and not making the body practice harder than it needs to be.
chapters.coreMove: Strip false difficulty from a body skill so live correction can reach the basic movement.
chapters.commonMisread: The weak version says simplify means make the practice casual, easy, or medically transformative.

chapters.title: Programming
chapters.sourcePressure: The source frames programming as a cognitively dense domain where breakdown, real-problem iteration, and avoidance of endless research matter more than abstract study hoarding.
chapters.coreMove: Force a technical skill into a runnable slice where output, error, and debugging can teach the next move.
chapters.commonMisread: The weak version says learn to code by building anything or by ignoring concepts entirely.

chapters.title: Touch Typing
chapters.sourcePressure: The source frames touch typing as habit repair: replacing an old motor pattern, tolerating frustration, and using consolidation only in service of corrected repetition.
chapters.coreMove: Protect the slower corrected motion long enough for it to displace the familiar wrong pattern.
chapters.commonMisread: The weak version says touch typing is just a speed drill or a willpower test.

chapters.title: Go
chapters.sourcePressure: The source frames Go as strategic complexity made approachable through pattern recognition, local attack and defense pressures, and the decision not to wait for total mastery before beginning.
chapters.coreMove: Enter a complex strategic field by reading one local pattern and one pressure instead of waiting to understand the whole board.
chapters.commonMisread: The weak version says pattern recognition means memorizing tricks or pretending the full complexity is small.

chapters.title: Ukulele
chapters.sourcePressure: The source frames ukulele through deliberate narrowing, isolated repetition, and a small public-performance standard rather than total instrumental breadth.
chapters.coreMove: Build a tiny performance subset until it can survive real ears, not just private hope.
chapters.commonMisread: The weak version says pick an easy instrument and play casually until confidence appears.

chapters.title: Windsurfing
chapters.sourcePressure: The source frames windsurfing as environment-shaped practice where staged isolation of subskills and risk-aware progression make a condition-dependent skill trainable.
chapters.coreMove: Shrink a condition-shaped skill to one live subskill that can be repeated safely and then tested by the real environment.
chapters.commonMisread: The weak version says either throw yourself into full chaos or hide forever in drills.
